newsitem.title: USA: Lynch Corp to sell broadcast co for $400,000.
newsitem.headline: Lynch Corp to sell broadcast co for $400,000.

text.p: Lynch Corp said on Friday that it had entered into a contract to sell a direct satellite TV broadcast company to Pegasus Communications Corp for $400,000 in cash and stock.
The transaction is expected to close in the second quarter and to generate a net profit of $150,000, or $0.11 per share, Lynch Corp said in a statement.
The broadcast company being sold, Lafayette County Satellite TV, is based in Wisconsin, Lynch said.
Lynch is a diversified company with subsidiaries in multimedia, services and manufacturing.
